d: Mohun Bagan Super Giant secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over Odisha FC in an exciting Indian Super League encounter. Dejan Dražić scored twice for the Mariners, while Mahmoud Eid and Everton Nascimento found the net for Odisha FC. Lee Erwin scored the decisive winner to seal Mohun Bagan's fourth consecutive victory and strengthen their position at the top of the ISL table.
